criteria.criterion: General Mills beat Adjusted Diluted EPS guidance in 2023
General Mills beat Adjusted Diluted EPS guidance midpoint in 2024
General Mills beat Adjusted Diluted EPS guidance twice in the past 2 years

reason: The answer confirms a fiscal 2024 beat ($4.52 against guidance of 4% to 6% growth from $4.30). It says it could not check fiscal 2023, so it never confirms the 2023 beat or the count of two. It gives the first fiscal 2025 guidance as -1% to +1% from $4.52, which works out to $4.47–$4.57, and adds later cuts. None of this is a direct conflict: the 2023 gap is an omission, and the later cuts are added detail.
